descriptionChirho: To bring under control or dominion by force, whether territory, land, or peoples, in the basic active Qal stem.
To overpower a person sexually, to assault or violate, a specialized and distinct usage of the Qal stem (cf. Esther 7:8).
To be brought under subjection or dominion, the passive of conquest or subjugation, including being enslaved.
To cause others to be subjugated or forced into servitude, the causative stem emphasizing compulsion and enslavement.
To subdue or conquer with intensive or thorough force, the Piel intensive stem indicating complete subjugation.
